metaTitle: What Tent Person Capacity Really Means
description: Tent capacity counts sleeping pads, not comfort. Learn the floor-area math, wall shape effects and how many sizes to go up for gear and cots.
directAnswer: Tent capacity is the number of sleeping pads that fit shoulder to shoulder with almost no room left. For comfort, gear, cots or kids, plan on going up one to two sizes, and judge by floor area and peak height instead of the label.
